question: Fit a least-squares line to Accessories units sold in completed orders per quarter over the 8 quarters of 2024 and 2025. What does it project for Q1 2026?

sql_attempts.sql: WITH quarters AS (SELECT '2024-Q1' AS q_label, 1 AS x, '2024-01-01' AS start_date, '2024-03-31' AS end_date UNION ALL SELECT '2024-Q2', 2, '2024-04-01', '2024-06-30' UNION ALL SELECT '2024-Q3', 3, '2024-07-01', '2024-09-30' UNION ALL SELECT '2024-Q4', 4, '2024-10-01', '2024-12-31' UNION ALL SELECT '2025-Q1', 5, '2025-01-01', '2025-03-31' UNION ALL SELECT '2025-Q2', 6, '2025-04-01', '2025-06-30' UNION ALL SELECT '2025-Q3', 7, '2025-07-01', '2025-09-30' UNION ALL SELECT '2025-Q4', 8, '2025-10-01', '2025-12-31'), q_data AS (SELECT q.x, SUM(oi.quantity) AS y FROM quarters AS q JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_date >= q.start_date AND o.order_date <= q.end_date AND o.status = 'completed' JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id AND p.category = 'Accessories' GROUP BY q.x), stats AS (SELECT AVG(x) AS mean_x, AVG(y) AS mean_y, SUM((x - (SELECT AVG(x) FROM q_data)) * (y - (SELECT AVG(y) FROM q_data))) / SUM((x - (SELECT AVG(x) FROM q_data)) * (x - (SELECT AVG(x) FROM q_data))) AS slope, AVG(y) - (SUM((x - (SELECT AVG(x) FROM q_data)) * (y - (SELECT AVG(y) FROM q_data))) / SUM((x - (SELECT AVG(x) FROM q_data)) * (x - (SELECT AVG(x) FROM q_data)))) * AVG(x) AS intercept FROM q_data) SELECT slope * 9 + intercept AS projected_units_q1_2026 FROM stats LIMIT 500
